full_prompt_en: A square expressionist city painting looks across a crowded industrial district built along a canal. The foreground is a broad pedestrian approach leading from the lower center toward arched bridges and tightly packed buildings. Small dark figures walk in groups along the path, their bodies rendered as quick vertical marks rather than individual portraits. To the left, dark water and moored boat shapes run alongside the street, while another curved channel and bridge appear deeper to the right. Across the middle and upper half, ochre, rust, cream, and gray facades overlap at many heights, punctuated by steep roofs, towers, chimneys, and dark windows. Several arched structures cut through the lower city, creating repeated passages into the distance. Smoke rises from the far buildings and merges with a turbulent green-gray sky, where broad pale swirls move over the rooftops. The architecture is recognizable but compressed into angular planes and broken color patches, making the city feel dense and restless. Black drawing and short scratch marks define selected doors, railings, figures, and masonry, while rough brushwork blurs the joins between neighboring structures. Light filters through the smoky sky from above, catching pale roof edges and the central path; alleys, water, and building recesses remain dark brown and blue-green. Warm red-orange accents appear in a few walls and street-level areas but never dominate the earthy range. No street sign or text is legible. The overall composition drives inward through people, bridges, and stacked facades, creating a layered, smoky vision of urban movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义城市绘画望向一片沿运河建成的拥挤工业城区。前景是一条宽阔步道，从下方中央引向拱桥与密集建筑。小小深色人物三五成群沿路行走，身体以快速竖向痕迹而非单独肖像描出。左侧，深色水面与停泊船形沿街延伸；右侧更深处也有弯曲水道与桥。中部和上半幅，赭黄、锈色、奶油与灰色立面高低重叠，陡屋顶、塔、烟囱与深窗穿插其中。几座拱形结构切过下方城区，形成通向远处的重复通道。烟从远方建筑升起，融入翻动的绿灰天空，宽大的浅色旋流扫过屋顶。建筑可辨却被压成棱角平面与破碎色块，让城市显得密集而躁动。黑色线描与短刮痕定义局部门、栏杆、人物和砖石，粗笔触模糊相邻结构的接缝。光从烟天上方透下，触及浅色屋缘和中央路径；巷子、水面与建筑凹处留在深棕与蓝绿中。暖红橙强调出现在少数墙面和街面，却未压过土色范围。没有可读街牌或文字。整体构图经由人群、桥与层叠立面向内推进，形成层次丰富的烟雾城市运动景象。
style_prompt_en: Expressionist city painting compresses many angular planes, arches, and vertical marks into a dense but navigable surface. Ochre, rust, gray-green, cream, and deep brown overlap in broken patches, with black scratch lines sharpening selected edges. Broad smoky swirls soften the upper field while tighter strokes crowd the lower focal area. Light is filtered and uneven, catching pale ridges while recesses remain deeply colored. Repeated passages and converging bands guide the eye through the texture rather than letting detail become noise. The result is restless, earthy, and atmospheric.
style_prompt_zh: 表现主义城市绘画把大量棱角平面、拱线和竖向痕迹压进密集却可穿行的表面。赭黄、锈色、绿灰、奶油和深棕以破碎斑块重叠，黑色刮线锐化局部边缘。宽阔烟云旋流软化上部区域，下方焦点则挤满更紧的笔触。光经过过滤且分布不均，击中浅色棱脊，让凹处保持浓色。重复通道与汇聚色带引导视线穿过肌理，使细节不沦为杂音。整体躁动、土质而富于氛围。
theme_en: A crowded industrial city along a canal under smoky clouds
theme_zh: 烟云下，一座拥挤工业城市沿运河展开
name: Max Weber
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
